newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ building consents rise in yr to May - SNZ.
newsitem.headline: NZ building consents rise in yr to May - SNZ.

text.p: New Zealand non-residential building consents rose in value by 10.7 percent in the year to May to NZ$2.46 billion, Statistics NZ (SNZ) said on Friday.

Consents worth NZ$283.9 million were issued for non-residential buldings in May, up from NZ$183.8 million in April, primarily due to consent for a proposed new parliamentary Building, the organisation noted.
Consents for residential buildings rose 1.3 percent to NZ$3.56 billion in the May year.
SNZ added the total value of all consents issued in the year was NZ$6.01 billion, up five percent on the previous year.
